source_storage: Source text remains on the original disc; bind by inventory ID and SHA-256.

notes.1: The reinforced item is omitted in the source and depends on the active equipment screen. Passive English preserves that omission.
notes.4: The item being lightened is omitted in the source and depends on the active equipment screen. Passive English preserves that omission.
notes.40: First half of a composed free-block warning; keep the newline before the runtime number.
notes.41: Suffix after the runtime block count. Preserve the leading space.
notes.43: VM executable means the memory-unit program, not a desktop virtual machine.
notes.52: Prize-money data is a game-specific record; retain data rather than inventing an award action.
notes.55: Opponent-specific overweight restriction; verify which unit exceeds the limit in-game.
notes.57: Armor compatibility: the source unit/body term does not establish whether the restriction is model-specific. Verify another model on the equipment screen.
notes.58: MARCS V2 is the system name; preserve it without inventing an acronym expansion.
notes.79: Option is the equipment category; retain the category name.
